title: Cloak
summary: A cloak was an outer garment used for warmth, covering, travel, pledge, and sometimes symbolic action.
background: Because a cloak could serve as protection and bedding, the law guarded the poor from losing it overnight. Cloaks also appear in prophetic and discipleship scenes.
teachingHelp: Explain the cloak as a practical garment of daily life, especially where poverty or discipleship is in view.
